subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible payload format should Feishu card-action callbacks use when `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, or `options` are present?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but linked attempts differ between structured JSON pass-through and command-text appending, and the choice affects existing command-style card actions and downstream agent/plugin parsing.

options.title: Structured JSON payload
options.body: Pass `action.value` together with Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text, while explicitly preserving legacy simple button behavior and documenting the contract in tests.

options.title: Command-text append
options.body: Keep `value.command` dispatch as the primary path and append form/select fields into command text, reducing command breakage but making complex values harder to parse reliably.

options.title: Close stale PR, keep issue
options.body: Close this PR as the stale implementation attempt and keep the canonical issue open for a maintainer-sponsored replacement.

recommendation.title: Structured JSON payload
recommendation.body: Pass `action.value` together with Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text, while explicitly preserving legacy simple button behavior and documenting the contract in tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names m1heng as the Feishu plugin contact, and the decision is specific to the Feishu channel payload contract.
